items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Tucker Green was playing drums... That's where I first met all of that gang... Melba Liston was with the band.

ctx.x: had Jimmy Bunn playing piano and writing for the band, and Hobart Dotson, one of fine trumpet players, and Tucker Green was playing drums, and... He had a fine band. Melba Liston was with the band. She was writing and playing her trombone with the band. That's where I first met all of that gang, you know. It was really, really nice.

And Eddie Heywood downstairs... Just activity. It was full of activity. On Central Avenue, they had several after-hour places also. Around 29th they had the Jungle Room. And the thing was Jack's Basket Room.
